name: [☠️] Survive Tsunami For Anime!
desc:
Welcome to Escape Tsunami For Anime! 🌊

[HOW TO PLAY]
1. Travel through the map and unlock new zones 📍
2. Escape from oncoming Tsunamis 🌊
3. Collect better Anime the further you go! 💪
4. Earn Cash and build your Anime collection 💯

💸The further you explore, the more valuable Anime you can find!
😍Remember to check back every day, your Anime earn Cash OFFLINE! 
🏆Play with others and compete to be the best!

Like and favourite the game if you enjoy! 🔥
Join the group for rewards and codes 🤝
